scope: Read-only research reflection over registered valid metatypes and their existing current member sets

primary_abi_sources.evidence: The intermediate RTTI classes add virtual functions but no data; single-inheritance RTTI adds one base-type pointer
RTTI base-pointer layout for a single public nonvirtual base at offset zero
Nonstatic method ABI supplies this as the first pointer argument

runtime_guards: Only already loaded images from the recorded deployment are retained using RTLD_NOLOAD
Every required exported function and RTTI symbol must resolve before registry traversal
std::type_info::name checks expected native class identities
typeid of RTTI objects checks the single-inheritance representation before reading the base pointer
The two recovered MetaType base RTTI pointers must be identical
Root MetaType RTTI must have the no-base class representation
All registry subtype classifications use the native __dynamic_cast with hint zero
rtti_evidence.raw_layout_read: One base-type pointer is copied from each validated single-inheritance RTTI object at sizeof(std::type_info), matching the installed 16-byte prefix
rtti_evidence.file_pointer_warning: The inspected Mach-O uses chained fixups; static encoded pointer values are never used as runtime addresses

getter_evidence.abi: Registry pointer; this pointer plus an actual libc++ vector reference, return value discarded
getter_evidence.caller_evidence: NsBase10.dylib MetaTypes.List at 0x14a82c-0x14a834 constructs and fills a vector; metaTypes implementation reserves and appends pointers

getter_evidence.methods: MetaType::identifier, baseIdentifier, name, addInIdentifier, version; UniqueString::name
getter_evidence.abi: Identifier getters return pointers; string getters return const std::string references; version returns uint32
getter_evidence.caller_evidence: NuCommands10.dylib addMetaDataNode passes name/addin and UniqueString::name results directly to ToIString(const std::string&); getter bodies return embedded addresses or load pointer/word

getter_evidence.abi: Pointer to an existing MemberSet; UINT32_MAX selects current set
getter_evidence.caller_evidence: Vendor schema dumper uses UINT32_MAX; both getters tail-call read-only lookup routines and do not initialize sets

getter_evidence.abi: Boolean, uint32, Member pointer, MemberSet pointer, MetaType pointer respectively
getter_evidence.caller_evidence: Getter instructions compare the initialization pointer, load a 32-bit count, index the pointer array by index times eight, or load pointers; MemberSet::meta setter accepts MetaType* and validates entity/value subclasses

getter_evidence.methods: Member::id, scriptId, debugTypename, meta, isSet; MemberMetaType::type
getter_evidence.abi: Three const std::string references, MemberMetaType pointer, Boolean option-mask test, uint32 category
getter_evidence.caller_evidence: Member::toString passes embedded id/debug-type strings to ToIString; JSONGetMembersVisitor passes scriptId to string operations; isSet is a pure bit inclusion test; category predicates compare values zero through six

return_codes.0: Reflection captured and output successfully written
return_codes.1: Invalid output path or output I/O failure
return_codes.2: Loaded image or required symbol unavailable
return_codes.3: Main-thread, deployment, RTTI, or category guard failed
return_codes.4: Reflection bounds, text validity, or C++ exception failure

output_contract.file_mode: 0600, O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW; existing files are never replaced
output_contract.data: Metatype name/id/base/addin/version, entity/value/member/other classification, member category, own/base set chains, member registration index/name/script id/debug type/member metatype, raw option mask
output_contract.uninitialized_sets: members is null, not an empty proven schema

limitations: The libc++ header version differs from the vendor's symbol suffix; ABI namespace/layout checks and native caller evidence do not replace runtime validation
The bridge does not establish the actual installed libc++abi runtime's source revision; LLVM 15.0.7 is a pinned declaration reference checked against observed native RTTI layout
C++ exceptions are handled; native faults, process termination, and invalid pointers cannot be recovered by this bridge
Main-thread execution is required; the caller must ensure the registry is quiescent and avoid nested failed task dialogs
Only the valid registered type list is traversed; invalid/unregistered types and uninstantiated historical member sets are not synthesized
Raw option bits are exported without unproven names or semantics
Member registration order is not asserted to be wire order
Custom serializers, migration behavior, transient fields, template element details, and binary widths remain separate reverse-engineering work
No schema initializer, document mutation, preference setter, Segment.Save, or Segment.Load is called
Native application code is required only for this authorized research oracle, never for production Kit conversion
CaptureSchema.py verifies the recorded native-library digests before invoking the bridge; the C++ entry point itself checks deployment path only
